title.zh: Visa财报：稳定币结算年化规模超250亿美元，同比增长10倍
title.en: Visa财报：稳定币结算年化规模超250亿美元，同比增长10倍

current_state.zh: Visa reported on its FY2026 Q4 earnings call that stablecoin settlement has surpassed a $25B annualized run-rate (roughly 10x YoY), now spanning 10 blockchains and 5 stablecoins, with over 225 stablecoin card programs and Visa Direct stablecoin pre-funding and cross-border flows entering commercial production.
current_state.en: Visa reported on its FY2026 Q4 earnings call that stablecoin settlement has surpassed a $25B annualized run-rate (roughly 10x YoY), now spanning 10 blockchains and 5 stablecoins, with over 225 stablecoin card programs and Visa Direct stablecoin pre-funding and cross-border flows entering commercial production.
